summary: Scoped V2 evidence and publication audit. Fixed staff catch-all bypasses, unverified-email staff authority, unaudited edits, missing controlled withdrawal/reopening, and stale-draft publication. Emulator regressions cover ownership, transitions, immutable history and protected grades. This is not a certification of all legacy collections or live deployment.

findings.issue: GitHub attribution and ancestry are instructor assertions checked in the browser. Firestore cannot authenticate Git evidence. Concurrent reclaim creation can require renewed review.
findings.recommendation: Retain explicit teacher verification and no automatic publication. Consider a trusted GitHub verification service and transactional claim coordination before unattended grading.

findings.issue: Roles retain the two verified-email mappings; provider credentials remain browser-managed and GitHub associations student-supplied.
findings.recommendation: Migrate institutional roles to managed custom claims and provider calls to a server proxy in a separately reviewed change.

findings.issue: Audited student changes require coordinated rules activation. Old deployed rules reject revision fields and withdrawal/reopening.
findings.recommendation: Obtain explicit deployment confirmation, coordinate release, and smoke-test real roles. No deployment was performed.
